title: OSDR Environmental Data App - ISS / ground telemetry (T, RH, CO2) and radiation per Rodent Research / APEX / VEG mission
unit_source: axis labels in EDA static/js/telemetry_plots.js ('Degrees [C]', 'RH [%]', 'CO2 [ppm]') and radiation_plots.js ('Dose [mGy/day]'); table headers Temp_degC_*, RH_percent_*, CO2_ppm_*
notes: *_iss columns = ISS cabin / flight unit sensors, *_ground = ground-control habitat; ground dates were shifted to match flight dates (per EDA mission note).
CO2 is present only for RR missions (APEX/VEG pages carry only temperature and RH).
Radiation doses: 'Doses are in water based on standard conversion from dose in silicon ... preliminary analysis ... SRAG, NASA-JSC'. accumulated_mGy is cumulative.
Values are mission-period snapshots (2014+), not a continuous ISS record.

columns.name: mission
columns.description: OSDR payload id, e.g. RR-1 (Rodent Research), APEX, VEG

columns.name: time_utc
columns.description: Controller_Time_GMT in the EDA table; cadence 1, 5, 10 or 15 min depending on mission

files.note: daily means of eda_telemetry_raw.csv per mission; same units, column suffix _mean

columns.name: gcr_mGy_per_day
columns.description: galactic cosmic ray absorbed dose, in water (converted from Si)

columns.name: saa_mGy_per_day
columns.description: South Atlantic Anomaly (trapped protons) absorbed dose

columns.name: accumulated_mGy
columns.description: cumulative sum of total over the mission (cumulative, NOT per day)
